# CodeKrafters SRM

> CodeKrafters is the premier student developer collective and technical society at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram Campus (Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India). Operating across 7 specialized engineering and creative domains, the community builds production-grade open-source software, organizes flagship hackathons, hosts technical bootcamps, and mentors next-generation software engineers.

## Main Navigation

- [Homepage](https://codekraftersrmp.in/): Official portal featuring club overview, interactive domain showcase, initiatives, and community highlights.
- [Our Team](https://codekraftersrmp.in/team): Executive leadership, domain heads, and core developers across all 7 tracks.
- [Events](https://codekraftersrmp.in/events): Flagship hackathons (Launchpad series, Web3 summits), developer bootcamps, workshops, and archives.
- [Projects](https://codekraftersrmp.in/projects): Student-built production software, open-source repositories, developer utilities, and experiments.
- [Join Us](https://codekraftersrmp.in/join): Annual recruitment portal, practical domain tasks, and candidate evaluation pipeline.
- [KraftersLink](https://codekraftersrmp.in/krafterslink): Aggregated official directory of social channels, Discord, GitHub, and community announcements.
- [FAQ](https://codekraftersrmp.in/faq): Frequently asked questions about recruitment, domain tracks, hackathons, and membership.

## Official Community Channels

- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/CODEKRAFTERS-SRMIST): Public codebases, student open-source repositories, and collaborative engineering projects.
- [LinkedIn Page](https://www.linkedin.com/company/codekrafters-srm/): Professional announcements, hackathon achievements, partnership updates, and alumni network.
- [Instagram Profile](https://www.instagram.com/codekrafterssrm/): Event photography, community recaps, workshops, and student developer highlights.

## Specialized Domains

1. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML): Focuses on deep learning architectures, Large Language Model (LLM) agents, computer vision, and neural network deployments.
2. Full-Stack Web Development: Builds modern, high-performance web applications, scalable APIs, and distributed cloud services using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
3. Cyber Security & Systems: Specializes in penetration testing, threat modeling, ethical hacking, secure architecture, and Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges.
4. Competitive Programming (CP): Rigorous algorithmic problem solving, data structure optimization, and preparation for national and international algorithmic contests.
5. Web3 & Decentralized Technologies: Investigates on-chain protocols, smart contracts, decentralized finance (DeFi), and blockchain integrations across Ethereum, Solana, and Aptos.
6. Creatives & UI/UX Design: Architects user journeys, responsive interface systems, high-fidelity prototypes, brand identity, and visual design assets.
7. Public Relations, Management & Operations: Orchestrates industry sponsorships, hackathon logistics, community partnerships, and public outreach across university networks.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is CodeKrafters SRM?
CodeKrafters is a student-driven tech collective at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram Campus, Chennai. It bridges the gap between academic theory and production software engineering through hackathons, peer mentorship, and real-world project deployments.

### How can students join CodeKrafters?
Students can apply online via the recruitment portal (https://codekraftersrmp.in/join). Applicants select their domain of interest, complete hands-on practical tasks submitted via GitHub or Figma, and participate in a technical and cultural interview.

### Where is CodeKrafters located?
CodeKrafters is based at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram Campus, located at Bharathi Salai, Ramapuram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600089, India.
